Polymarket is a prediction market platform that lets users trade on the outcomes of real-world events. Polymarket settles its markets on the Polygon blockchain. Polymarket uses USDC as its settlement currency. Polymarket represents market outcomes as tradable outcome tokens. Polymarket resolves market outcomes through the UMA optimistic oracle.

DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization that operates without a central authority. DAO rules are encoded in smart contracts on a public blockchain. DAO members make decisions by voting on proposals.
